changes.summary: Add reusable browser environment leases, bounded owned-driver shutdown and structured lifecycle diagnostics.

Preserve environment lifecycle failure and compensation causes with structured operation, environment and artifact diagnostics; execute up to four NDJSON requests concurrently with synchronized replies and EOF cleanup.

Unify served series colours across plots, legends and print tables; label the current period in comparison tooltips; add opt-in persistent totals for additive charts, including empty and fully hidden data.
Verify delayed npm package and provenance visibility without cached metadata, preserve immutable publication retries, and distinguish timeouts from integrity conflicts.
Add context-aware required migration advisory locking on the shared maintenance database, reusing the canonical lock while preserving legacy best-effort behavior.
